_note: sessionStart (inject-state.sh) is LOCAL-ONLY; Cursor cloud agents do not run sessionStart (per https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks). All other hooks run in cloud and local.
_shape_c_note: Shape-C policy hooks (evaluate-*-policy.sh) delegate to the attest-mcp policy engine. Reintroduce when Cursor adds the hook.
